sections.name: revealStyle
sections.title: Tests for how work is shown
sections.what: Runs four checks: future work shows as a blueprint only when future work is on; in-progress work fades in as its date progress grows; finished work stays solid and undated work stays hidden; and the realistic style never shows the terrain grid.
sections.why: Likely reason: these are the visible rules a user would notice on screen.
sections.watch_out: The grid check depends on the realistic style setting, so changing that setting will fail this check on purpose.

summary: Checks that the rules for showing, fading and hiding project work behave as intended for each work state and progress value.
purpose: Protects the visibility rules for 3D work from changing by accident.
why: Likely reason: the rules decide what a user sees during the schedule playback, so they are checked directly.
how: Runs four checks in order: future work, in-progress fade, finished or undated work, and terrain grid by view style.
inputs: Sample work states and progress values written in the file, such as future, active, complete and unavailable.
outputs: A pass or fail result for each check.
risks: Only the sample points are checked. Values between them are not checked.
debug: If a check fails, compare the expected value in the test with what the reveal function returns for the same state and progress.
